description: This Dart source file defines the NotesDb class, which manages local storage of notes using SQLite via the sqflite package. It provides methods to open, close, query, insert/update (upsert), mark notes as deleted, and retrieve dirty notes, facilitating local data persistence for a note-taking application.

classes.name: NotesDb
classes.description: A class handling SQLite database operations for notes storage, including creation, querying, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and returns an instance of NotesDb by opening (and creating if necessary) the database file.

methods.name: queryAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes matching optional search criteria and tags, with an option to include or exclude deleted notes.

methods.name: getByLocalId
methods.description: Fetches a note record by its local identifier.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note record in the database with provided values.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted by updating its 'is_deleted' flag and related fields.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Retrieves all notes marked as dirty for synchronization or processing.
